verdict.rationale: One homepage claim says Vercel can "run production workloads in isolated containers," which glancingly touches the story. Nothing in the pack shows deploying a Dockerfile or prebuilt image, and the documented deploy flow is Git push or CLI for supported frameworks. Missing for 10: explicit Docker image/Dockerfile deployment support, documentation of the container deploy workflow (build, registry, runtime config), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
